scoring_justification: Recomputing magnetic ground state trends (spin-state transitions, energy ordering) from the agent's raw magnetic_data.csv using paper-reported thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for Mn moment low/high spin in FM, FIM existence window, FIM high-spin moment, and energy crossing derived from paper text and figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures (Fig.1, Fig.2, and discussion of critical lattice parameters)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's explicit statements: a<7.0 Å low-spin Mn (0.5–1 µB), a>7.1 Å high-spin Mn (≈2 µB); FIM solution only for a>7.17 Å with Mn>1.7 µB; energy crossing at a≈7.5 Å.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported quantitative bounds for the magnetic transitions and energetic crossover.

outputs.description: Raw DFT total energies and site-projected magnetic moments for all spin configurations as a function of lattice parameter, used to verify the paper's reported spin-state transitions, energetic proximity, and stabilization trends.
